text:
Sam I: seeing a surge of GPU warm-pool starts failing in prod-usw2, nodes stuck in Initializing since ~12:10 UTC. audit-shipper showing KMS decrypt errors. can we check firewall microseg rollout?
Anya C: I'm looking. I deployed a microseg egress tighten yesterday (rule: microseg-egress-tighten) to reduce blast radius. applied 12:09 UTC. pulling diffs now.
Kyle O: same pattern in a couple of clusters — kubelet can't reach keystore, node join stalls. probably why warm-pool keeps retrying and keeping GPUs spun.
sec-bot: Policy-change detected: fw rule microseg-egress-tighten applied by Anya C @ 2026-03-23T12:09:02Z. Affected destinations: *.keystore.prod.internal:443, logs-shipper.prod.internal:443
Anya C: confirmed. diff shows deny to keystore CIDR for non-controlplane subnets, intended to block lateral app-to-app. mistakenly included keystore egress tag.
Sam I: can we add an emergency allowlist to restore keystore egress? audit logs are missing — compliance risk.
Dina M: yes please. audit-shipper failing KMS decrypt = logs stuck local. compliance will flag missing audit trail if >1h. Also ML jobs are sitting pending GPUs. cost heads-up: warm-pool is burning resources while retrying.
Kyle O: temporary workaround: add SG allow for keystore CIDR from node-subnet and restart audit-shipper. command to test from a node: ```curl -v --connect-timeout 5 https://keystore.prod.internal:443/health``` expected 200, currently TLS handshake failed.
Anya C: rolling a targeted rule revert + allowlist to node-subnets now. will keep deny for app-tier.
ML Oncall: quick heads-up on cost: we estimate ~2h of warm-pool retries at 100 GPUs -> ~200 GPU-hours if not paused. can someone throttle warm-pool scale?
Sam I: I can pause warm-pool autoscaling in the console, doing that now.
Anya C: reverted affected egress deny and added explicit allow for keystore and logs-shipper. pushing change, should be live in ~30s.
sec-bot: Config apply complete. change-id: cfg-87654.
Kyle O: nodes now show keystore health OK from tests. audit-shipper started TLS handshake and KMS decrypts resumed.
Dina M: audit logs catching up. starting replay of backlog to central SIEM. opening incident ticket INC-2345 to track compliance impact + cost exposure. owners: Anya (fix + postmortem), Sam (warm-pool throttling + cost), Dina (audit replay + compliance note).
Sam I: action items: 1) postmortem on why keystore tag was included in microseg rule; 2) stricter deploy-time checks against keystore CIDRs; 3) automatic canary to test keystore egress after fw changes.
Anya C: agreed. I'll start the postmortem draft and link firewall policy diffs.
ML Oncall: once audit replay completes, I'll send updated GPU-hours estimate.
Dina M: tagging security for review (@sec-team) and noting we need an expedited control exception process documented. :exclamation:
Sam I: thanks all — monitoring for 15m then will close thread.
